name: Random Quote
tagline: Inspiring quotes from famous authors and thinkers
description: Get a random inspirational, philosophical, or motivational quote with author attribution and topic tags. Filter by topic (inspiration, life, technology, etc.). Uses the free Quotable API — no API key required.

expert_defs.name: random_quote_get
expert_defs.description: Fetches random quotes from quotable.io. Params: tag (optional topic filter), count (1-5). Returns JSON with output_type json containing quotes with author and tags.

conceptTexts: Plugin: Random Quote (id: random-quote). Expert random_quote_get fetches random quotes from quotable.io (free). Params: tag (optional topic), count (1-5). Returns {output_type: 'json', data: {quotes: [{text, author, tags}], count}}.
